en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who did not know whether he had circumambulated six (circuits) or seven. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should do it again’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “About a man who does not know if he has performed six or seven Tawaf (walking around the House), abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
has said, ‘He must do his Tawaf again.’”
